subject: SIG v13: requested re-answers, impact matrix and evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Jane Dow <jane.dow@acmecloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG v13: re-answers and redlines request

Hi Vivek / Monica,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. AcmeCloud's security team has completed an initial review of the SIG v13 draft and attached some redlines and a handful of new/changed questions we need re-answers for. We need the updated SIG answers and a summary of any diffs to our vendor questionnaire portal by next Tuesday (Oct 6) to stay on track for our internal procurement window.

High level asks:
- Re-answer the 12 items flagged in the attached PDF with clear citations to evidence.
- Provide a short impact matrix that calls out answers that changed vs. new questions.
- For items referencing logs/retention, include the evidence artifact name or a link.

Can you confirm owners and whether you can meet the Oct 6 deadline? If you need a tighter scoping call, Rajesh and I can make time.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Dow
Director, Vendor Risk — AcmeCloud
[Attachment: SIG_v13_changes.pdf (pdf, 1.1MB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Jane Dow <jane.dow@acmecloud.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@acmecloud.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG v13: re-answers and redlines request

Hi Jane — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks.

Quick confirmation of internal owners so you have a single point of contact:
- Monica will own the questionnaire edits and final submission to your portal.
- Rishi will collect technical artifacts / evidence (logs, retention policies, architecture diagram).
- Priyom will review any legal wording for exposures and approve the final language.

Proposed timeline (we can accelerate if you need):
- Oct 2: internal mapping and evidence matrix (which items are straightforward vs. need product/infra input).
- Oct 4 EOD: draft re-answers and diff summary delivered to Acme for review.
- Oct 5: legal sign-off and final artifact bundle uploaded to your portal (Oct 6 if we need extra QA).

We should be able to meet Oct 6 but there are two items that may require a short caching/retention policy confirmation from infra (Rishi will flag). Monica — can you take point on the impact matrix and upload a working copy to the Drive link below?

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_sig_v13_evidence

If that timeline works for you, we'll proceed and keep you posted with the diff summary.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: SIG v13 -> mapping + evidence matrix (working doc)

Team — I uploaded an initial evidence_matrix.csv to the Drive (linked in Vivek's note). Short summary of my plan and asks below:

Plan:
- Triage the 12 flagged questions into three buckets: (A) no-change/confirm, (B) re-answer with existing artifact, (C) require new supporting artifact or policy clarification.
- Produce an impact matrix that lists question id, previous answer, proposed answer, evidence file name, and owner.
- Generate a diff_summary.pdf that highlights any wording changes in the answers (we'll keep the original phrasing in a column).

Asks:
- Rishi: please pull the retention logs for the last 90 days and confirm retention policy references for Q7 and Q9. Attach filename should be redwood-retention-logs-90d.tar.gz (or provide a Drive link).
- Priyom: please review the proposed wording for Q4 and Q11 — I'm suggesting we scope the answer to exclude aggregated telemetry (we shouldn't commit to sharing raw logs).
- Lauren: can you validate the stakeholder list and sign-off chain so I can record approvers in the impact matrix?

Attached: evidence_matrix.csv (working). I'll update the working copy as items move to closed.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_matrix.csv (csv, 45KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: SIG v13 -> mapping + evidence matrix (working doc)

Folks — quick tech status:
- I exported the 90-day retention logs and placed a stub in Drive: redwood-retention-logs-90d.tar.gz (restricted access). I'll coordinate with SecOps to grant Acme read-only access if we get their portal credentials or we can provide a sanitized CSV extract.
- For Q2 (KV cache isolation) and Q8 (multi-tenant throughput isolation), I can provide architecture snippets and a test-run report. Expect artifacts: arch-diagram-v2.png, isolation-test-report-20261002.pdf.
- Two blockers: 1) We need explicit permission to disclose certain internal runbook snippets (they mention specific hostnames). Priyom, do we lean to sanitizing hostnames or providing a high-level summary? 2) There is a legacy answer in the previous SIG that referenced a short-term pilot; we should change that to current-prod language.

I attached a short diff_summary.pdf that highlights the items I changed in my draft re-answers.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure
[Attachment: diff_summary.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: SIG v13 -> mapping + evidence matrix (working doc)

Checked the draft re-answers and redlines. My recommendations:
- Sanitize any hostnames and internal IPs; provide sanitized examples where helpful.
- For legal wording on telemetry and logs, use the phrase: "aggregated telemetry only; no raw customer payloads disclosed." That keeps us conservative but answerable.
- Approve providing read-only access to the retention CSV (sanitized) but do not provide full tarball without an NDA addendum — advise Acme accordingly.

I've attached a short doc (sig_reanswers_redlines.docx) with suggested re-wording for Q4 and Q11. If approved, Monica can paste this text into the portal answers.

Priyom
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sig_reanswers_redlines.docx (docx, 14KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Jane Dow <jane.dow@acmecloud.com>, Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG v13: re-answers and redlines request — submission plan

Jane / Rajesh — thanks for your patience. Quick status and links:

What we are sending you now (working bundle):
- Final draft re-answers for all 12 flagged items (pasted into your portal and attached as a single export).
- Diff summary (diff_summary.pdf) that shows changes vs our prior SIG answers.
- Evidence matrix (evidence_matrix.csv) that maps each question to an artifact and owner.

Access and artifacts:
- Drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_sig_v13_evidence
- HubSpot ticket for tracking: 005-ACME-SIG-2026
- We will not upload the full retention tarball to your portal; instead we will provide a sanitized CSV extract unless a mutual NDA addendum is completed.

Next steps we propose:
1) Monica will paste the answers into your vendor portal tonight.
2) We will add the diff_summary.pdf and evidence_matrix.csv to the portal.
3) If you need the retention tarball for internal audit, please confirm and we'll route the request through legal for an NDA addendum (Priyom will coordinate).

Please confirm receipt and whether you want the sanitized CSV added to the portal or prefer the NDA route. If you want any follow-up clarifications, we can schedule a 30-min readout this week.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Attachments: diff_summary.pdf (pdf, 120KB); evidence_matrix.csv (csv, 45KB)]
